issue.title: SASE Symvision reports nine unused public symbols once the RecoveryAssessment private-import finding is fixed
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-dw.1 note #1 (epic bob-cli-dw, phase recovery-assessment-public); confirmed by the bob-cli-dw land agent.

At SASE master 196690f6cb, `just _lint-symvision` (and `sase tool run check`, run 3b58ef8eb1bd8498480675b58b13b724) fails with nine "Unused public functions/classes" findings:

- ArtifactLinkCollisionPartition in src/sase/sdd/_artifact_link_event_collision.py
- FinderFeature in src/sase/ace/tui/modals/statistics_footprint_finder_modal.py
- SnapshotEvidence in src/sase/finalizers/_failed_close_recovery_snapshots.py
- admission_sequence_for in src/sase/sdd/_artifact_link_event_quarantine.py
- candidates_from_tier in src/sase/sdd/_artifact_link_event_store.py
- discover_nested_git_repos in src/sase/workspace_provider/_snapshot_nested.py
- overlay_payload in src/sase/footprint/query.py
- reduce_events in src/sase/sdd/_artifact_link_event_canonical.py
- review_settings in src/sase/footprint/query.py

Root cause: these symbols are public but not imported outside their defining module. They predate epic bob-cli-dw. Symvision was masking them: it reports the private-import class first and stops. The land agent swapped the pre-dw.1 versions of the two failed-close modules back in, and symvision then reported only `_RecoveryAssessment`. Once bob-cli-dw.1 made RecoveryAssessment public, the unused-public class surfaced. Governed-check triage already marks them KNOWN (witnesses 9776966ba92b346679ba5e84a6a2ec0f, 9e04a76d13c4daed2b75a61367f4d292; no owner).

Remediation: read SASE `symvision.md` memory first. Then, per symbol and following its decision hierarchy, delete it if dead, make it private if used only in its file, or add a justified pragma only where policy allows. Do not whitelist to get green. Verify with `just _lint-symvision`, then `sase tool run check` in the opened sase checkout. Note that an external sase checkout without an opened sase-core uses the published sase-core-rs 0.42.7 pin, so the failed-close recovery tests need SASE_CORE_DIR pointed at an opened sase-core (bob-cli-di note #2).

task_type_fields.node_id: sase::check::lint(symvision)::unused-public (ArtifactLinkCollisionPartition, FinderFeature, SnapshotEvidence, admission_sequence_for, candidates_from_tier, discover_nested_git_repos, overlay_payload, reduce_events, review_settings)
task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic static lint: identical nine findings from just _lint-symvision on clean master 196690f6cb and from governed check 3b58ef8eb1bd8498480675b58b13b724; triage already marks them KNOWN.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-dw.1 fixed the RecoveryAssessment private import, which exposed nine pre-existing unused-public Symvision findings that keep SASE's governed check red with no owner.
